description: Vessel electrical-systems general arrangement comprising three coordinated plan views: an upper interior/equipment layout from stern at left to bow at right, a lower systems/accommodation layout, and an enlarged engine-room plan at right. Structural stations/frames are marked longitudinally A through M and numerically 2 through 11. The drawing maps distributed equipment by location rather than showing detailed circuit wiring. Major system relationships visible are: the aft lazarette/transom and steering area interfaces with the aft technical/accommodation spaces; the amidships engine room contains two main propulsion engines with adjacent auxiliaries, pumps, filters, electrical equipment and port/starboard fuel tanks; this machinery zone interfaces fore-and-aft with tanks and service equipment and laterally with hull-side systems. Forward of the engine room are port and starboard fuel tanks, grey/black/waste-water tanks and freshwater/service equipment, continuing into guest/owner accommodation and the bow. The lower systems plan locates accommodation services and HVAC/water/waste appliances across port and starboard guest cabins, crew areas, galley, saloon, studio, owner’s cabin and head. Readable schedule headings identify cross-system groups including Main Steer Hardware, Steering, Appliances, Main Propulsion, Generator, Exhausts, Grey Water, Stern Thruster, Fresh Water, Raw Water & Cooling, Bilge & Fire, Grey Water, Black Water, Fuel, Air Suspension, Fresh Water Hydraulics, Pneumatics, Refrigeration, Aircon, Ventilation, Power Generation, Power Conversion and Energy Storage. Connectivity is primarily spatial/functional: twin propulsion engines and engine-room auxiliaries connect to the port and starboard fuel-tank/service zones; cooling, exhaust, bilge/fire, hydraulic, pneumatic, ventilation and electrical-generation/conversion/storage systems converge in or route through the engine room; freshwater, grey-water, black-water and HVAC services distribute from machinery/tank spaces to the labeled cabins, heads, galley, crew mess, saloon, studio and owner spaces; steering hardware is concentrated aft near the transom/lazarette and linked forward through the vessel systems layout. Exact individual line-to-line circuit endpoints are not legible at this image resolution.
